run_metadata.coverage_summary: Attempted the full source universe (Tier 1 core government, Tier 2 broader public sector / GBE, Tier 3 private). Direct page retrieval remained fully blocked this run: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested (the AusTender ATM list and individual ATM detail pages), and the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (selective=false, recentRelayFailures empty). Per proxy policy, 403 org-policy denials were not retried or routed around, so no tender detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened directly; all capture is from WebSearch snippets, cross-verified across multiple independent queries, with any item whose close date had already passed (or could not be corroborated) rejected. Two genuinely new currently-open opportunities were captured this run, both Commonwealth via AusTender: (1) Director of National Parks ATM 16456 - open RFT for Buffel Grass Management at Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park (published 16 Jul 2026, tenderer questions due 6 Aug 2026, closes 13 Aug 2026 12:30pm ACT; draft agreement 8 Oct 2026 - 7 Oct 2030 + 1yr option; contact dnpprocurement@dcceew.gov.au); and (2) Department of Defence S-EST11118 - Duntroon minor building remediation (multi-building demolition, painting, rust removal, ablution and workplace refurbishment; mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, civil and structural works; ACT; closes 30 Jul 2026 12:00pm ACT, closing-soon; tender administrator Aurecon, SNSW.PDS.Tenders@aurecongroup.com). Ten previously-seen opportunities whose published close dates are still in the future were carried forward with their original first_seen dates (Geoscience Australia GA2026/1392 GNSS CORS data streams, closes 18 Aug 2026; DCCEEW ATM_2026_6066 Australian Bushland Program Purchasing Partners REOI, closes 3 Aug 2026; Australian Army LCD-26-0030 Army Innovation Day 2026 RFI, market-sounding; CSIRO CSIRORFT2026019 Ground Maintenance VIC Metro, closes 17 Aug 2026; City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI, closes 10 Aug 2026; Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Culvert Unit Supply, closes 4 Aug 2026; DCCEEW ATM_2026_6786 GEMS verification-testing laboratory panel, closes 12 Aug 2026; Western Power Clean Energy Link PCMS EOI, closes 31 Jul 2026 closing-soon; ANSTO PSC002897 ILWCI+ construction industry-briefing / upcoming RFT, market-sounding; SA Water Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade D&C EOI, close date still behind SA Water's registration-gated Supplier Portal). Seven genuinely new buyer-originated sources were recorded this run - the Director of National Parks (Parks Australia) as an AusTender buyer, plus six energy/water GBE and utility e-procurement portals not previously in the known-source set: Hunter Water (TenderLink), Essential Energy (newly migrated to an Oracle Cloud 'Tenders and Suppliers' portal, a notable rebrand off TenderLink), Seqwater (Zycus Supplier Network + Queensland Government Supplier Portal), Sunwater (registers via QTenders), SA Power Networks (own Supplying-to-us / Tenders channel) and Jemena (TenderLink). Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos and energy/construction majors) was checked as required: no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login, so no corporate tender was captured (portals remain registration-gated or invitation-only). Zero tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: Direct page retrieval fully blocked again this run. WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested (https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm and multiple https://www.tenders.gov.au/Atm/Show/... detail pages); the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (selective=false, recentRelayFailures empty). The proxy README instructs not to retry 403/407 policy denials. Consequence: no ATM/RFT/EOI/REOI detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened; all detail is limited to cross-verified WebSearch snippets. Source-document deliverables/requirements extraction (evaluation-criteria weightings, full document lists, mandatory conditions) was not possible for any entry this run.

Carry-forward verification limit: the ten previously-seen opportunities were retained because their published close dates are still in the future (all >= 30 Jul 2026, except the two market-soundings and SA Water which has no recoverable close date). Because of the 403 wall they could not each be individually re-opened this run to confirm they had not been withdrawn or amended; they are carried forward on the basis of their prior-run detail plus future close dates, not a fresh document read.

SA Water Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade D&C EOI: existence, buyer (SA Water), EOI nature and multi-stage design-and-construct scope carried forward from prior runs, but the exact EOI reference, closing date/time, evaluation criteria and value remain visible only inside SA Water's registration-gated Supplier Portal and could not be recovered behind the 403 wall - retained at headline+scope level with closing_date null.

ANSTO ILWCI+ (PSC002897) and Army Innovation Day 2026 (LCD-26-0030) are market-soundings (industry briefing / RFI), not open RFTs; exact briefing dates, interest-registration deadlines, RFI closing date and document lists remain behind the AusTender 403 wall (closing_date null).

City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI and Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Culvert Unit Supply: carried forward and still open by close date, but exact tender reference numbers, evaluation criteria and document lists remain unrecoverable behind the TenderLink / buy.nsw 403 + registration walls (headline level).

Western Power Clean Energy Link PCMS EOI: carried forward, closing within days (EOI due 31 Jul 2026, closing-soon). Exact EOI reference, evaluation criteria and value remain behind the registration-gated + 403-blocked Opportunities Hub.

Search snippets again surfaced closed/stale items as if current (e.g. AusTender EST09297 Palmer Barracks civil works - closed ~Jan 2026; ATM_2026_6026 DCCEEW solar-panel-recycling pilot - closed 24 Apr 2026; RFT-2026-0080 Federal Court Primary Dispute Resolution - closed 7 Apr 2026; PR10031930 RASS air services - published 27 Mar 2026, recency/closing unverifiable). These were date-checked and REJECTED, not recorded. ATM_2026_6251 and 77680 could not have their recency or closing date corroborated and were left out rather than guessed.

Tier-1 state/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria / buyingfor.vic, QTenders / supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were reachable only as landing pages via search; individual open state tenders generally could not be drilled into or date-verified behind the 403 wall, so apart from the carried-forward TfNSW HW4 Culvert package and City of Sydney EOI no new state/local-portal opportunity could be confirmed at a trustworthy level of detail this run.

Tier-3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, EstimateOne construction packages): checked as required. No publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; corporate opportunities remain registration-gated or invitation-only, so none were captured as tenders (no corporate entries fabricated).

SA Power Networks - https://www.sapowernetworks.com.au/industry/tenders/ - South Australian electricity distribution network (privately operated); publishes tenders and a 'Supplying to us' onboarding channel. Utility buyer worth watching.
